title: The town-centre service stations: Shell (Hindmarsh Rd), Caltex (Torrens St), Liberty (Victoria St)
why: Asked about by residents: the accesses and nearest junctions of the three town-centre service stations, plus Inman St / Newland St beside Liberty.
junctions_used: Shell: Hindmarsh Rd nodes cluster_11174609013_649114783 and 50904904#12.-20; Caltex: the right-before-left car-park nodes 13163189011-36 by Torrens St / Coral St; Liberty: Victoria St node 1842610521 and Victoria St / Inman St (1948685925); Inman St / Newland St (531031939)

scenario_descriptions.bp: Brent's package (four-lane ring road, two-lane McCracken roundabout, roundabout slip lanes)
scenario_descriptions.cp: Council's town-centre package (30 km/h centre, shared zones, one-way loop, signals)
scenario_descriptions.n7: N7: roundabouts at Armstrong/Crozier, Armstrong/Greenhills and Hindmarsh/Grantley
scenario_descriptions.n9: N9: Crozier Rd turn lanes at Armstrong Rd + Hindmarsh Rd / Grantley Ave roundabout
